title: Expose daemon process memory and vector-store heap footprint diagnostics
wanted_capability: A read-only MCP/admin surface that reports daemon process memory (RSS, anonymous, swap, referenced) and an approximate in-memory footprint per vector partition, so operators can distinguish a leak from expected steady state without scraping /proc and store files. Per-partition active/deleted counts already exist (bbox_embed_status include_diagnostics -> vector_diagnostics); /admin/runtime-metrics reports only Tokio scheduler metrics and scheduler latency.
fallback_used: Read /proc/<pid>/status, /proc/<pid>/smaps_rollup, pmap, bbox_stats, bbox_embed_status, and vector store files manually.
evidence: src/embed_runtime/status_snapshot.rs vector_diagnostics (active/deleted counts, no byte footprint)
notes: Observed prod blackboxd idle at ~11.7G RSS, ~11.6G anonymous, ~3.5G swap, with vector store persisted size 8.7G. /admin/runtime-metrics only exposes Tokio scheduler metrics.
